farewellMessage:
“𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐬.”



As I am no longer working as a Foley artist, sound designer, and recordist, I’ve decided to proudly close this chapter of my career in the film industry after several highly productive years and move on to something new.

For those I haven’t had the chance to tell personally yet:

A big thanks to everyone I’ve had the pleasure of working with — for all the passion, knowledge, energy, fun and trust that went into creating so many great projects together🙏🎉


I look back on these years with a great sense of accomplishment.


And… Cut!🎬😎
